title: Blanche - Should You Fight Her? (The Fountain Quest)
description: Blanche at The Fountain in Expedition 33 is a choice, not just a boss. Sparing every friendly Nevron earns 100 Colour of Lumina - fighting her means you killed one.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Blanche is a friendly White Nevron found at The Fountain - and whether you fight her at all depends entirely on choices you made across two acts.

This is the payoff of the friendly Nevron questline. It is not simply a boss to tick off.

sections.title: Where to Find Blanche
sections.content:
Location: The Fountain - inside the middle of the mountain, west of Spring Meadows.

Reaching it requires Esquie's flight ability, so it is an Act 3 location.

On entry you get the Entrance Expedition Flag. Follow the path and interact with Blanche. There is also a Journal - Expedition 84 down the left path - worth grabbing on your way back.

sections.title: The Choice: Reward or Fight
sections.content:
Your historyWhat happens
You spared every friendly White NevronBlanche gives you 100x Colour of Lumina and the Aiding the Enemy achievement. There is no fight.
You killed any friendly NevronBlanche fights you instead. Beating her drops Colour of Lumina x10 and Grandiose Chroma Catalyst x2.

The comparison is stark: 100 Colour of Lumina for sparing, versus 10 for fighting. Sparing is worth roughly ten times as much, and it is not close.

sections.title: If You Want the Reward: Do Not Attack Friendly Nevrons
sections.content:
This is the single most important thing on this page. A single kill anywhere in the friendly Nevron questline locks you out of the 100 Colour of Lumina reward.

  • Do not attack the friendly White Nevrons you meet in Acts 1 and 2
  • Even if you want the drops from killing them, do that after you have spoken to Blanche - not before
  • If you have already killed one, the reward is gone for that playthrough and Blanche will fight you

sections.title: What the Questline Involves
sections.content:
The friendly Nevron quests you need to have handled run through Acts 1 and 2. Notable participants include:

  • Jar and Demineur
  • Benisseur in the Red Woods - this one requires escalating Chroma donations (5,000, then 10,000, then 25,000, then 50,000). He rewards Pictos along the way
  • Hexga and other friendly White Nevrons

Whenever one offers you a choice, spare. That is the condition.

sections.title: Achievement
sections.content: Sparing every friendly Nevron and claiming the reward unlocks Aiding the Enemy.
